cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Take My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're Alex's friend too. Explain that alternating allotment weekends is a fair rota, please, not me abandoning him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We agreed all three of us would go every Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's attendance, not a division of work. Show him the covered weekends first; nobody's plot is being left untouched.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll talk to him, but you have to admit you changed the agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I will. Say I changed it to keep us from resenting every Saturday together. 'Changed,' please, not 'walked out.' He needs to hear the difference.

reason: Use precise rota and wording corrections to recruit shared-friend interpretation while accepting B demand to acknowledge the changed agreement.
